description: The fifth season moves through alien contact, bodily transformation, artificial minds, time loops and future oppression, with ordinary people repeatedly discovering that extraordinary technology carries a price its inventors failed to calculate.

s05e01.description: A skeptical radio host who mocks alien believers is shaken when one caller's extraordinary claim ends in public tragedy and evidence he can no longer dismiss.

s05e02.description: A critically ill doctor receives a perfectly matched transplant with astonishing speed and begins investigating where the organs came from and why the match was possible.

s05e03.description: A prison electronics expert builds tiny mechanical helpers that attract the attention of inmates planning an escape, turning his private creations into dangerous bargaining chips.

s05e04.description: An alien servant from the oppressed Grell species rescues his human owner's family after their aircraft is attacked, forcing both sides to reconsider a society built on slavery.

s05e05.description: A scientist links the minds of brain-dead patients in an attempt to restore consciousness and accidentally creates a shared reality with consequences outside the laboratory.

s05e06.description: An astronaut who once aborted a Mercury mission after seeing mysterious lights returns to space decades later and finally confronts what happened during the original flight.

s05e07.description: Human crews enslaved by sentient warships begin realizing that their machines depend on them more than the system admits, creating an opportunity for rebellion.

s05e08.description: A mysterious well-dressed stranger arrives at a homeless shelter carrying his memories in a box while unseen forces repeatedly alter who he is.

s05e09.description: After an electrical accident, an anxious apartment resident discovers she can hear the thoughts of everyone around her and learns that privacy was protecting more than politeness.

s05e10.description: A fertility treatment secretly uses genetic material claimed to come from the Shroud of Turin, placing an unsuspecting couple at the centre of an attempt to manufacture a messiah.

s05e11.description: A predator that inhabits women's bodies creates a new series of killings resembling Jack the Ripper and frames the man trying to expose its true nature.

s05e12.description: A lawyer prosecuting a Nazi war criminal receives impossible evidence from a time traveller capable of returning to Auschwitz in 1944.

s05e13.description: Genetically engineered workers on an off-world mining colony demand independence from Earth and force human negotiators to confront the system that created them as property.

s05e14.description: A timid scientist tests a genetic serum intended to unleash human competitiveness and discovers that the primitive traits it awakens are not interested in professional advancement.

s05e15.description: Residents of a highly automated apartment complex must cooperate for the first time when the system supplying every need begins failing in increasingly dangerous ways.

s05e16.description: A teleportation experiment traps its lead scientist in a repeating sequence of hours before a catastrophic test, forcing him to identify the sabotage before time resets again.

s05e17.description: A meteor strike apparently kills a man, but something inside his body takes control and walks away, revealing an alien process that may be spreading through humanity.

s05e18.description: An illegal designer drug lets users experience encounters with dead loved ones, offering emotional reunion at the cost of addiction, delusion and eventual self-destruction.

s05e19.description: A lonely teenager befriends an alien survivor after a crash on Earth and must decide how far to protect the first being who seems to understand him.

s05e20.description: A young man investigates the care home where his grandfather has been sent and discovers that disturbing dreams among the residents point to a hidden programme.

s05e21.description: In a war-torn future, fugitives carrying a biological weapon seek help from a casino owner whose past relationship may determine whether their mission survives.

s05e22.description: A murder suspect claims an alien is controlling him and transmits mental images to a detective, while a second witness tells her partner a very different version of events.
